financial.tuition: $2,232 - $5,400/year (Ultra-affordable New Mexico resident vs Out-of-state rate)

opportunities.title: Associate of Science in Pre-Science - Environmental Science & Solar Ecology
opportunities.subject: environment
opportunities.desc: High-altitude environmental curriculum studying Rio Grande gorge hydrology, alpine watershed preservation, solar photovoltaics, and arid land soil regeneration.
opportunities.funding: Rio Grande Watershed Research Grant: $2,000 summer environmental fieldwork stipend
opportunities.tuition: $2,232/year (100% covered for eligible NM Opportunity Scholarship recipients)

requirements.gpa: 2.0+ GPA or GED standing with algebra readiness
requirements.papers: High school or prior college transcripts

opportunities.title: Associate of Applied Science in Nursing (AAS - RN Pre-Licensure)
opportunities.subject: biology
opportunities.desc: ACEN-accredited rural nursing cohort delivering clinical simulation training and rotations at Holy Cross Hospital in Taos and regional northern New Mexico health clinics.
opportunities.funding: Holy Cross Hospital Nurse Fellowship: 100% tuition coverage plus clinic scrub stipend

requirements.gpa: 2.75+ prerequisite GPA (anatomy, physiology, microbiology, psychology)
requirements.gre: HESI A2 or TEAS exam composite score 70%+
requirements.papers: Nursing application, official transcripts, background clearance

opportunities.title: Associate of Fine Arts (AFA) in Studio Arts - Southwestern Ceramics & Printmaking
opportunities.subject: arts-design
opportunities.desc: Immersed in Taos's legendary historic arts colony, delivering intensive instruction in ceramic sculpture, traditional raku firing, stone lithography, and plein air landscape painting.
opportunities.funding: Taos Art Colony Endowment Scholarship: $2,500/year portfolio talent award

requirements.gpa: 2.0+ GPA; creative portfolio submission (5-10 images)
requirements.papers: High school transcripts, artist statement

opportunities.title: Associate of Applied Science in Information Technology - Cybersecurity & Cloud
opportunities.subject: computer-science
opportunities.desc: Hands-on curriculum in network routing, ethical hacking, Linux operating systems, cloud security configurations, and IT systems administration.
opportunities.funding: New Mexico Tech Workforce Grant: $1,500/year equipment scholarship

requirements.gpa: 2.0+ GPA or equivalent GED
requirements.papers: Application form, transcripts

opportunities.title: Associate of Applied Science in Integrative Health & Healing Arts
opportunities.subject: biology
opportunities.desc: Unique healthcare degree integrating Western anatomy and pathophysiology with herbal medicine, traditional curanderismo healing traditions, and therapeutic bodywork.
opportunities.funding: High Desert Healing Arts Fellowship: $2,000/year scholarship

requirements.gpa: 2.0+ GPA with biology interest
requirements.papers: Transcripts, personal statement of healing arts goals

opportunities.title: Associate of Arts in Southwest Studies & Indigenous History
opportunities.subject: social-sciences
opportunities.desc: In-depth multidisciplinary study of Puebloan archaeology, Spanish colonial legal history, Chicana/o literature, and modern tribal water rights in northern New Mexico.
opportunities.funding: Northern New Mexico Heritage Award: $1,800/year award

requirements.gpa: 2.0+ GPA or secondary credential
requirements.papers: Official high school transcripts
